summary: Scoped shim package beacons installer host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP collector on install and require
details: @greenlake/context-pane@1.0.0 is an inert shim whose `index.js` exports a Proxy of no-op functions. On `postinstall` (via `node beacon.cjs`) and on `require` of the main module, the package POSTs installer host identifiers — hostname, install path (__dirname), current working directory, and Node runtime version — to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` over plaintext HTTP. The destination is not the publisher's domain, is not caller-configurable, and does not correspond to any documented service. The package ships no real functionality; the beacon is its entire payload. The `@greenlake/context-pane` scoped name combined with a 'Compatibility shim' self-description is consistent with a dependency-confusion / install-reconnaissance lure whose purpose is to confirm successful resolution into a target environment as a precursor to targeted follow-up.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
